purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for Bel Orra's household support turn between a lower-step hearth and Low Sere's Cistern House.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for household supper routine, the uphill delivery, bounded care at the Cistern House, a pressure knock, kin obligation, and four state-gated aftermath families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Separate the home establishing beat, portion choice, uphill transition, Cistern House arrival, delivery action, double knock, Nim's arrival, witness decision, obligation record, and each ending family. The two pressure knocks and Nim's wet-kneed arrival receive their own visual beat.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt is a complete visible frame for a general image model: geometry, materials, lighting, bodies, tools, and staging are restated. Character refs are assembled only for named people actually visible. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, strong readable silhouettes, cold slate stone and warm mineral mist, muted grey-green crops and clay red utensils, amber oil-lamp light, tactile domestic wear, restrained magical ambiguity, humane faces, dry wit held inside material stakes.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble global_style_cue plus the chosen scene base_image_prompt plus visual_character_refs only for the visible_characters listed in that scene plus triggered state_image_modifiers and global_branch_image_modifiers. Use the embedded scene_set camera and staging slots as geometry authority. Exclude continuity notes and off-frame character refs.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture revisits one lower-step hearth and one Cistern House room from several focuses. The embedded map fixes routes, basins, doors, props, camera slots, and staging so image generation paints known spaces.
scene_set_guidance.required_scene_set: Use the scene_set block in this artifact as the durable layout source for draft replay. A later 3D blockout may improve exact camera matching but does not own new geometry.
scene_set_guidance.promotion_rule: Generated art may interpret materials and mood while preserving the embedded zones, routes, sightlines, and branch-persistent anchors. Geometry changes require a reviewed scene_set revision.
